# Wild Rider

> Wild Rider offers car rental, 4x4 car rental and camper rental in Costa Rica, including budget long-term rental, with the best rates in the country.

The website is available in English (default, no URL prefix), Spanish (/es/), German (/de/) and French (/fr/). The pages below link to the English version; the same page exists under each language prefix.

## Vehicles and booking

- [Our cars and reservation](https://wild-rider.com/our-cars-and-reservation/): the rental fleet of 4x4 vehicles and campers, with details for each vehicle.
- [Quote](https://wild-rider.com/quote/): request a quote for a vehicle.
- [Long-term rental](https://wild-rider.com/longtherm-rental/): long-term rental options.
- [Camping](https://wild-rider.com/camping/): camping and camper information.

## Pick-up, insurance and safety

- [Airport pick-up and office location](https://wild-rider.com/airport-pick-up-and-office-location/): where and how to pick up the vehicle.
- [Insurance](https://wild-rider.com/insurance/): insurance information.
- [Road safety](https://wild-rider.com/road-safety/): road safety information for driving in Costa Rica.

## About and support

- [About us and our team](https://wild-rider.com/about-us-and-our-team/): who Wild Rider is.
- [Testimonials](https://wild-rider.com/testimonials/): customer reviews.
- [FAQ](https://wild-rider.com/faq/): frequently asked questions.
